name: 🐙 GitHub Triage
description: Issues in → labelled, answered, assigned — with you approving every reply before it goes out. A webhook trigger, a workflow, and the gh CLI. Point a repository's webhook at the office and the queue empties itself.

commands.name: setup
commands.desc: Install the triage workflow + a webhook trigger for that repository; returns the URL to paste into GitHub

commands.name: triage
commands.desc: Triage one issue right now (no webhook needed)

commands.name: status
commands.desc: Repositories wired up, and the last runs

library.needs: the gh CLI logged in (gh auth login); a tunnel (cloudflared / ngrok) for GitHub to reach the hook
